_CURRENT_SCOPE_NOTE: This JSON file targets the stable 1.x bridge path that can call precise from the old GUI.
For the recommended GUI-only high-precision path, use config/pdf2zh_next.openai.toml with pdf2zh_next GUI instead.
_REQUIRED_USER_INPUT_BEFORE_USE: If you use the official OpenAI API, keep OPENAI_BASE_URL as https://api.openai.com/v1.
If you use an OpenAI-compatible proxy, change OPENAI_BASE_URL and make sure it ends with /v1.
This file is for the stable byaidu/pdf2zh Docker image, with OpenAI kept as the translator but BabelDOC/precise evaluated as the second-stage path.
This file does not force precise mode by itself. In the GUI, switch Translation Mode from fast to precise only after regular OpenAI translation is already working.
In stable 1.x GUI, even launching with -i while thinking in terms of precise does not automatically move the dropdown default away from fast.
_QUALITY_FIRST_MODEL_NOTE: gpt-4.1-mini is kept here as the documented starting point for compatibility.
For final mathematical-paper runs in precise mode, replace OPENAI_MODEL with the strongest OpenAI-compatible model you actually trust and can access.
_RUNTIME_REMINDERS: Use this only after config/config.json has already been verified with a successful OpenAI translation.
For the first precise test, keep pages to First or a very small range and keep threads low.
Do not mix Ollama or additional proxy experiments into the first precise trial.
If you use CLI without GUI, the structured v2 path is the --mode precise route; the older direct experimental path is --babeldoc.
_GUI_FIELDS_NOT_CONTROLLED_BY_THIS_FILE: Translation Mode still has to be changed manually in the stable 1.x GUI dropdown from fast to precise.
number of threads is still a GUI runtime textbox and is not prefilled from this file.
Pages and Ignore cache are still runtime GUI choices.
_GUI_ONLY_PRECISE_RUNBOOK: 1. Start from an OpenAI configuration that already succeeded once.
2. Open the stable GUI and confirm Service=OpenAI.
3. Switch Translation Mode from fast to precise.
4. Keep Pages=First for the first precise validation run.
5. Set threads=1 for the first precise validation run.
6. Turn on Ignore cache when testing a changed formula regex or changed mode.
7. Only after a clean first-page result should you move to larger page ranges or the full paper.
_MATH_PAPER_NOTES: BabelDOC formula/style processing depends heavily on formula font identification, style grouping, and offset recovery.
For Japanese target output, BabelDOC's supported-languages table is structurally favorable because Japanese is listed with no ligature dependency.
At the same time, BabelDOC historically focused most heavily on English-to-Chinese, so a first-page validation remains important before full-document runs.
_STABLE_GUI_LIMITATIONS_FOR_PRECISE: Even in precise mode, stable 1.x GUI does not surface many pdf2zh_next/BabelDOC advanced controls such as glossary files, table-text translation, OCR policy, primary font family, or compatibility bundles.
Therefore the practical high-precision GUI-only strategy is not 'turn on every hidden feature', but rather 'use OpenAI + precise + strong formula font protection + conservative validation sequence'.
